q: Should we count on a cleaner grid to meet our reduction target?
title: A cleaner grid and your targets
short: You can expect it, but report it honestly. India plans a much larger share of non-fossil power, so the CEA grid factor should fall over time. Your Scope 2 will drop even if you do nothing. Show how much of each year's fall came from the grid factor and how much from your own actions.

ul: Emissions at the base year factor, to isolate your own action.
The difference, labelled as the grid effect.

p: Do not plan on the grid alone. Buyers and lenders look for efficiency, fuel switching and renewable power you control.

senseible: Senseible reads fuel invoices and electricity bills and applies IPCC 2006 factors and the CEA grid factor (0.710 kg CO2 per kWh), so you can compare Scope 1 and 2 before and after a change from the documents themselves.
